exposure: Case-based simulations of delivery scenarios for SARS-CoV-2 positive pregnant women
outcome: Minimizing risk of exposure to healthcare professionals
Facilitating provision of care to SARS-CoV-2 infected pregnant women and their infants
Integrating simulations into daily clinical routine
cohort: The study's cohort is the health care provider team involved in reviewing and implementing management guidelines for SARS-CoV-2 positive pregnant women and their infants during delivery.
finding: Simulation of delivery of SARS-CoV-2 positive pregnant women can minimize the risk of exposure to healthcare professionals, and integrating these simulations into daily clinical routine is feasible.
mod_finding: The management guideline incorporates various methods of delivery, including normal vaginal delivery and emergent cesarean section, as part of the simulated scenarios.
